title: Moot the motion for Palestine in Parliament, don’t be hypocrites, says Perikatan leaders | The Star
text:
Moot the motion for Palestine in Parliament, don’t be hypocrites, says Perikatan leaders | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: Opposition leaders called on the Government not to be hypocritical in their support for Palestine by refusing to bring the matter to the Parliament.
In a rally in front of the US embassy here on Saturday (Oct 28), Opposition Leader Datuk Seri Hamzah Zainuddin and PAS President Tan Sri Abdul Hadi Awang said that the government should allow the opposition to discuss condemning the Zionist Israeli regime over the latest aggression against the Palestinians.
